description: This file defines the SkillModel class for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It is a model representation used for API serialization of Skill entities, including properties such as id, name, and description.

classes.name: SkillModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing Skill entities in the API responses, implementing Normalizable and utilizing ModelTrait.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SkillModel with a Skill entity and sets filtering properties for serialization.
